*.{js,mjs,cjs}: docker compose run --rm quality-runner npx eslint --fix
docker compose run --rm quality-runner npx prettier --write
docker compose run --rm quality-runner npx jsdoc --validate
*.{json,md,yml,yaml}: docker compose run --rm quality-runner npx prettier --write
*.feature: docker compose run --rm quality-runner npx markdownlint --fix
docker compose run --rm bdd-runner npx cucumber-js --dry-run
package.json: docker compose run --rm quality-runner npm audit --audit-level moderate
docker compose run --rm quality-runner npx license-checker --onlyAllow 'MIT;Apache-2.0;BSD-2-Clause;BSD-3-Clause;ISC'
